summary.t: A spotted cap on a wooden stem. Three colours.

text.t:
A pale wooden stem under a painted cap — red with white spots, soft beige, or deep brown. The light comes out through the spots.

One of the smallest pieces, and the best of them in a group: three mushrooms together on a shelf make a small wood.

options.power.help.t: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.engraving.help.t: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
